## UI polish: Checkout box 12 fixes across Spacing, Typography, States and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.box` `padding: 15px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Typography**: `.pay` has no font size, so the browser's default for buttons (about 13.33px) applies. That is off the scale and below 16px. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Typography**: `.pay` has no font family, so the browser's default button font applies. Now `font-family: var(--font-family-sans)`, the same font as the box. (R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Typography**: the `.box h2` heading has no line-height. Now `line-height: 1.25`. (R-ui-polish-3) 5. **Typography**: `.box p` has no max-width. Now `max-width: 65ch`. (R-ui-polish-3) 6. **States**: `.pay` has no hover style. Now `.pay:hover` uses `background: #333333`, the same neutral hue, 12.63:1. (R-ui-polish-6) 7. **States**: `.pay` has no focus style. Now `.pay:focus-visible` uses `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **States**: `.pay` has no disabled style. Now `.pay:disabled` uses `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 9. **Tokens**: colours whose values equal a token. The `.box` `background: #ffffff` is now `var(--color-surface-default)`. The `.pay` `color: #ffffff` is now `var(--color-action-primary-text)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Tokens**: `.box` `font-family: system-ui` is now `var(--font-family-sans)`, which adds the `sans-serif` fallback. (R-ui-polish-20) 11. **Tokens**: type values. `font-size: 20px` is now `var(--font-size-xl)`, `font-size: 16px` is now `var(--font-size-md)`, and `line-height: 1.5` is now `var(--line-height-body)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 12. **Tokens**: spacing and target size. `margin: 0 0 12px` is now `0 0 var(--space-12)`. `padding: 12px 24px` is now `var(--space-12) var(--space-24)`. `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px` is now `var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading "Order total" | #1f2937 on #ffffff, 14.68:1 | #1f2937 on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 14.68:1 | | Body paragraph | #1f2937 on #ffffff, 14.68:1 | #1f2937 on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 14.68:1 | | "Pay now" button | #ffffff on #111111, 18.88:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #111111, 18.88:1 | | "Pay now" button, hover | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #333333, 12.63:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```html

Order total

You will be charged when you confirm.

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: #111111 on the "Pay now" button, with the tokens' teal (#0f766e) used only for the focus ring. - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - The heading and paragraph text use #1f2937 (14.68:1). The token --color-text-default is #202d2c (14.26:1). I kept #1f2937; say if the token should win. - The primary button uses #111111 (18.88:1). The token --color-action-primary-bg is #0f766e (5.47:1). I kept #111111; say if the token should win. - The button hover colour #333333 has no matching token. If the button moves to the brand fill, its hover would be --color-action-primary-bg-hover (#0c403c, 11.58:1). - The heading line-height of 1.25 has no matching token, because tokens.css has no line-height token for headings. Add one or confirm it stays. - The paragraph's 65ch max-width has no matching token, because tokens.css has no measure token. Add one or confirm it stays.
